patch_description: This implementation replaces long annealing with an orientation-cell homotopy strategy. It uses deterministic geometric seeds based on perturbed triangular lattices, quickly improves them with batched lower-tail mutations, and then performs repeated epigraph SLSQP polishing inside the currently discovered determinant-sign cell. The sign-cell approach turns the absolute-area maximin objective into smooth constrained subproblems while periodically refreshing signs to allow transitions to better combinatorial arrangements. A cached result keeps repeated API calls inexpensive, and a deterministic valid fallback is retained.
